data.title: Add fuzzy ID matching
data.body:
## Goal

Support fuzzy matching for bug IDs, not just prefix matching.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket show ac1` matches `abc1` (missing character)
- [ ] `docket show ab1` matches `abc1` (missing character)
- [ ] Still prefer exact matches over fuzzy matches
- [ ] Still error on ambiguous matches
- [ ] Works for all commands that take bug IDs

## Context

Currently only prefix matching works (`ab` matches `abc1`). True fuzzy matching would be more forgiving for typos. Consider using a library like `fuzzy-matcher` or simple Levenshtein distance.

Lower priority since prefix matching works reasonably well.
